catalogConventions.coordinateConvention: Intrinsic-frame pixels after normalized x/y conversion; undo preview transforms without swapping anatomical sides.

exercises.description: Assigned-arm forward reach toward a fixed image target and return to rest.

requirements: Supervisor confirms stable seating and clinician-permitted support.
Record seated support and fixed target placement.
Keep assigned anatomical side and every required landmark observable.
Changing approved view or camera requires new setup.

requiredLandmarks.purpose: Upper-limb geometry and/or baseline-relative torso proxy.
Limb geometry and/or baseline-relative torso proxy.

supportRequirements.instruction: Record seated support and fixed target placement.

requirements: Capture stable resting shoulder/elbow/wrist/hip baseline.
Select fixed nonzero reference C1,C2 and target T; keep L, W0, T and torso baseline fixed.
Reject overlapping rest/target regions, insufficient reference or ambiguous forward direction.

metrics.label: Peak projected elbow angle
metrics.definition: Maximum accepted angle(S,E,W) in the outward interval; straight projected arm approaches 180 degrees.
limitations: Not a validated 3D or anatomical joint angle.

metrics.label: Peak forward torso inclination change (2D proxy)
metrics.definition: Peak max(0, signed shoulder–hip inclination change from rest); forward sign follows calibrated rest-to-target direction; retain signed samples.
limitations: Image vertical is not gravity or spinal alignment.

metrics.label: Peak normalized forward wrist displacement
metrics.definition: Peak wrist displacement projected onto fixed rest-to-target direction, divided by fixed reference L.
limitations: Not total path length, vertical elevation or physical distance.

metrics.label: Reach duration
metrics.definition: First accepted target-region entry time minus accepted onset time, divided by 1000; retain first timestamps in confirmed dwell.
limitations: Target-region entry does not establish physical contact.

exercises.description: Move the supported selected foot from prescribed rest toward its assigned pump endpoint and back.

requirements: Supervisor confirms stable seating and clinician-permitted support.
Clinician specifies supported lower-leg/foot arrangement; record support and footwear.
Keep assigned anatomical side and every required landmark observable.
Changing approved view or camera requires new setup.

requiredLandmarks.purpose: Foot visibility and shape checks; not a substitute angle vertex.
Foot-segment endpoint for the oriented foot proxy.

supportRequirements.instruction: Clinician specifies supported lower-leg/foot arrangement; record support and footwear.

requirements: Capture stable resting foot baseline with resolvable shank and foot in a close side view.
Record fixed screen-forward sign in unmirrored analysis coordinates and pump-direction sign (+1 or -1).
Verify prescribed outward-positive direction against a labeled small setup motion; reject ambiguity.
Fix and test sign/angle wrapping and nonoverlapping rest/endpoint bands at setup.
Reject a gap or angular step that makes unwrapping ambiguous.

metrics.label: Oriented projected shank-to-foot angle
metrics.definition: Signed atan2 cross/dot angle between knee-minus-ankle and foot-index-minus-ankle; use oriented angle rather than unsigned acos.
limitations: Foot-segment proxy; not validated anatomical ankle angle or clinical dorsiflexion.

metrics.label: Baseline-relative signed foot-angle change
metrics.definition: wrapTo180(screenForwardSign * (oriented angle minus baseline angle)); retain signed samples for inspection.
limitations: Screen-forward sign is fixed at setup; reject ambiguous unwrap intervals.

metrics.label: Peak prescribed-direction foot excursion
metrics.definition: Peak positive pumpDirectionSign times signed baseline-relative foot-angle change in the outward interval.
limitations: Direction must be calibrated; opposite-direction movement cannot satisfy prescribed endpoint.

metrics.label: Outward duration
metrics.definition: First accepted endpoint time minus first accepted onset time, divided by 1000; confirmation retains the first sample timestamp.
limitations: 2D projected estimate; valid phase and tracking evidence required.

metrics.label: Return duration
metrics.definition: First accepted rest time minus confirmed return-departure event time, divided by 1000; use exercise-specific sustained return guards.
limitations: 2D projected estimate; valid phase and tracking evidence required.
